title: Game audio post-production. Extra capacity when you need it.

sections.heading: Game audio post-production. Extra capacity when you need it.
sections.body: Professional dialogue editing, technical processing and delivery for original and localized game audio. An external team for production peaks and incoming batches.

sections.heading: You manage recording. We strengthen delivery.
sections.body: For game studios, publishers, recording studios and localization providers facing overlapping projects, extra languages or batches beyond their internal capacity.

items.title: Dialogue editing
items.body: Dialogue clean-up, voice editing and duration adjustments to agreed time constraints.

items.title: Technical processing
items.body: Levels, LUFS, true peak, sample rate and formats matched to the project specifications.

items.title: Asset preparation
items.body: Naming, folder structure, exports and organized final assets.

items.title: Delivery technical QC
items.body: Format, naming and consistency checks. Sync requirements and exception reporting within the agreed scope.

sections.heading: Recording continues. So does post-production.
sections.body: Send completed sessions as they become available. We begin post-production in batches while your studios keep recording, with deliveries coordinated around your milestones.
sections.note: Illustrative workflow; schedule and reviews are agreed per project.

sections.heading: SuiteQA. Dialogue context, connected.
sections.body: Our internal system connects script lines, recording IDs, audio references and QA decisions. It helps the team organize issues and follow production progress.

items.title: Status and issues
items.body: Recording, post-production and QA information within the workflow.

sections.alt: Actual SuiteQA screenshot: script lines, references and review decisions
sections.caption: SuiteQA · Internal audio and script review view.
sections.note: An internal production tool that keeps each line’s context available throughout review.

items.title: Overflow support
items.body: Extra capacity for production peaks, additional languages or late batches.

items.title: Recurring remote team
items.body: A team familiar with your specifications for ongoing workloads.

items.title: Multilingual post team
items.body: Shared delivery rules and production tracking across languages.

sections.heading: Additional support, separately scoped.
sections.body: Add-ons are scoped around the project’s needs and are not automatically included in post-production.

items.title: Preparation
items.body: Scripts, references, recording IDs, naming and Pro Tools sessions.

items.title: Technical audit
items.body: Review of sync rules, levels, formats and exception reports, also available as a standalone service.

items.title: Linguistic audio QA
items.body: Listening review for script mismatches, pronunciation and editing issues.

sections.heading: Have a batch coming up?
sections.body: Send the file count, languages, specifications and target date. We will review the scope and capacity required.
